The Agent provider.

- JVS Computer: set to OpenClaw.
- OpenClaw: set to OpenClaw.
- Hermes Agent: set to HermesAgent.
Specifies whether to include risk information.

description.zh:
Agent 运行时 ID，ID 对应关系如下：

- JVS Computer：JVS Computer ID，格式如 jvs-xxxx。
- OpenClaw：云电脑 ID，格式如 ecd-xxxx。
- Hermes Agent：Hermes Agent ID，格式如 jvs-xxxx。
description.en:
The Agent runtime ID. The ID mappings are as follows:

- JVS Computer: the JVS Computer ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx.
- OpenClaw: the cloud computer ID, in the format of ecd-xxxx.
- Hermes Agent: the Hermes Agent ID, in the format of jvs-xxxx.
The type of the Agent runtime.

title.zh: 查询Agent运行时的三方通道配置
title.en: Query third-party channel configurations of an agent runtime

descriptions.zh:
您可以查询无影 Agent 管理中心内的 JVS Computer、OpenClaw、Hermes Agent等 Agent 运行时的三方通道配置状态。

请确保在使用该接口前，已充分了解无影 Agent 管理中心的操作与使用。
descriptions.en:
You can query the third-party channel configuration status of Agent runtimes such as JVS Computer, OpenClaw, and Hermes Agent in the Wuying Agent Management Center.

Make sure that you are familiar with the operations and usage of the Wuying Agent Management Center before you call this operation.
